name: Cape Breton Highlands National Park
policyReason: Only the Skyline Trail and some beaches are closed to pets; the rest of the park allows them on leash.
summary: Leashed pets can use most of the park, but not the Skyline Trail or some beaches.

excerpts.quote: trail and in certain beach areas. Please comply with signage.
Pets must be kept on a leash at all times.

dogRules.text: No pets on the Skyline Trail or in certain beach areas; follow signs.
Pets must be leashed; pick up droppings.
No pets in equipped campsite tents or oTENTiks at Broad Cove.
No pets in oTENTik units at Mkwesaqtuk / Cap Rouge.
